label: Applying directly to a Polish university

milestones.label: Each university's own closing date
milestones.note: No national portal and no national date. Each university runs its own online registration (IRK) with its own dates, fee and requirements. They sit far apart: Poznan University of Medical Sciences opened for Fall 2027 on 1 September 2026 and closes on 20 July 2027, while most universities had published no 2027 dates at all by September 2026.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: Some Polish deadlines fall after this — Poznan Medical closes on 20 July. Where one closes earlier, ask the university how it takes IB results that arrive later.

supplementarySteps: Your IB Diploma needs no recognition statement from NAWA — say so if a form asks.
Choose HL subjects with the programme in mind. Polish universities convert HL and SL very differently, and some programmes require a science at HL.

notes: Applying directly is the finding, and one route covers every listed institution.
Per-university dates, including the 2026 ones carried as provisional, are on the country profile's deadline list.
